data.title: 阿米娅 · 舰上温室的指尖拭泪
data.description: 罗德岛绿意盎然的生态温室内，人造日光如细碎金箔洒满泥土与绿叶。阿米娅刚修剪完花枝，由于想起过去的牺牲者，眼底泛起无声的泪光。当博士伸出拇指轻柔拭去她眼角的泪珠时，阿米娅将脸颊依偎进掌心，展现出只属于两人的脆弱与依靠。
data.action: leaning into palm, tear wiped from cheek, tender vulnerable look
data.lighting: warm golden sunlight streaming through glass dome
data.mood: deep emotional bond and tender healing
data.promptProse: Surrounded by lush green foliage inside the Rhodes Island greenhouse, Amiya leans her soft cheek into the Doctor's caring palm as a tear is gently wiped away. Golden sunlight filters through the glass ceiling, illuminating her soulful brown eyes.
data.animaCaption: Amiya leaning into a comforting palm with soft teary eyes in the greenhouse.
